The record behind it is the user-stated decision #27 (trust 3). It comes after the earlier GPL-3.0 idea (#25), so I left GPL-3.0 out. The file doesn't mention any alternatives.

The repository also has a `LICENSE` file. I didn't open it or use it, since you asked for recorded decisions only. If its text doesn't match Apache-2.0, the two will disagree.
